subtitle: Top-Header Hyper Music & Performance Polish
changes: Moved the mobile HYPER MUSIC shortcut into the main website top header, away from the sticky navigation bar and bottom-left controls.
Preserved the existing bottom-left floating HYPER MUSIC shortcut on desktop and the same music player and stored tracks on both devices.
Added native lazy loading and asynchronous image decoding for offscreen thumbnails and other noncritical images to reduce initial loading work.
Optimized only newly inserted image elements instead of rescanning the full interface after every dynamic update.
Preserved all existing Talent Forge controls, saved data, archived studio access, Blizzard connections and the proven Discord update workflow.
